==Russian==

===Etymology===
{{inh+|ru|sla-pro|*močiti}}. Cognates include {{cog|de|machen}}, {{cog|grc|μάσσω}}, {{cog|la|mācerō}}, {{cog|lt|makonė}}.

{{sense|to kill, to waste}} Compare typologically {{m|ru|топи́ть}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{ru-IPA|мочи́ть}}
* {{audio|ru|LL-Q7737 (rus)-Cinemantique-мочить.wav}}

===Verb===
{{ru-verb|мочи́ть|impf|pf=намочи́ть,замочи́ть,промочи́ть,мочкану́ть<q:semelfactive>}}

# to [[wet]], to [[moisten]], to [[douse]], to [[humidify]]
# to [[soak]], to [[steep]]
# to [[dike]]
# to [[dunk]]
# to [[pickle]], to [[marinate]]
# {{lb|ru|slang}} to [[kill]], to [[waste]]
#: {{pf|ru|замочи́ть}}
